'''Roberta Kathleen Hunter''' {{post-nominals|country=NZL|MNZM|size=85%}} is a New Zealand education academic of [[Cook Islands Māori]] descent and as of 2019 is a full professor at the [[Massey University]]. She specialises in [[mathematics education]].<ref name="bio">{{Cite web|url=https://www.massey.ac.nz/massey/expertise/profile.cfm?stref=103830|title=Prof Roberta Hunter – Professor of Pasifika Education Studies – Massey University|first=Massey University, New|last=Zealand|website=www.massey.ac.nz}}</ref>

==Academic career==

After a 2002 [[MSc]] titled '' 'Constructing decimal concepts in an inquiry classroom' ''<ref>{{Cite thesis|url=https://mro.massey.ac.nz/handle/10179/6924|title=Constructing decimal concepts in an inquiry classroom : a thesis presented in partial fulfilment of the requirements for the degree of Master of Education at Massey University|first=Roberta Kathleen|last=Hunter|date=6 July 2002|publisher=Massey University |type=Thesis |via=mro.massey.ac.nz}}</ref> and  a 2007 [[PhD]] titled '' 'Teachers developing communities of mathematical inquiry ' '' at the [[Massey University]], Hunter joined the staff, rising to full professor.<ref name="bio"/><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.massey.ac.nz/massey/about-massey/news/article.cfm?mnarticle_uuid=F0CF48DC-E8F3-403F-74D8-7A7539502B9B|title='Bobbie maths' raising Pasifika achievement – Massey University|first=Massey University, New|last=Zealand|website=www.massey.ac.nz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nzherald.co.nz/nz/news/article.cfm?c_id=1&objectid=11633539|title=The Primary Issue: Ministry counts cost of children failing at maths|first=Kirsty Johnston Kirsty Johnston is an investigative reporter at the New Zealand Herald|last=kirsty.johnston@nzherald.co.nz @kirsty_johnston|date=4 May 2016|via=www.nzherald.co.nz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.cerme.nz/node/84|title=1: Developing Mathematical Inquiry Communities &#124; Centre for Research in Mathematics Education|website=www.cerme.nz}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://e-tangata.co.nz/korero/bobbie-hunter-maths-belongs-in-every-culture/|title=Bobbie Hunter: Maths belongs in every culture|date=5 August 2018}}</ref><ref>{{cite thesis |last=Hunter |first=Roberta |year=2007 |type=Doctoral thesis |title=Teachers developing communities of mathematical inquiry |publisher=Massey Research Online, Massey University |hdl=10179/3747 |url=https://mro.massey.ac.nz/handle/10179/3747}}</ref>

In the [[2020 Birthday Honours (New Zealand)|2020 Queen's Birthday Honours]], Hunter was appointed a [[Member of the New Zealand Order of Merit]], for services to mathematics education.<ref>{{cite web |url= https://dpmc.govt.nz/publications/queens-birthday-honours-list-2020 |title=Queen's Birthday honours list 2020 |date=1 June 2020 |publisher=Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet |accessdate=1 June 2020}}</ref>

== Selected works ==
* Hunter, Roberta, and Glenda Anthony. "Forging mathematical relationships in inquiry-based classrooms with Pasifika students." Journal of Urban Mathematics Education 4, no. 1 (2011): 98–119.
* Hunter, Roberta. "Facilitating communities of mathematical inquiry." Navigating currents and charting directions 1 (2008): 31–39.
* Hunter, Roberta. "Changing roles and identities in the construction of a community of mathematical inquiry." Journal of Mathematics Teacher Education 13, no. 5 (2010): 397–409.
